items.text: Bills ruled out DJ Moore (shoulder/AC sprain) for Thursday game; day-to-day, chance to play next week vs Chargers but not lock. Not serious.
items.why: AC joint sprain from landing on shoulder; X-rays.
items.implication: Bills WR depth tested; monitor for Week 3.
items.opportunity: Fast start in BUF before injury.

items.text: Ladd McConkey DNP 2nd straight day (ribs); unlikely available vs Raiders Sunday.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; consecutive DNPs.
items.implication: Johnston/Harris route share spikes; Herbert downgrade.
items.opportunity: Primary target Week 1 (5-82-1); 90%+ routes for others without him.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thu (2nd straight); Ja'Kobi Lane IR/return (wrist). If Flowers OUT, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.why: Hamstring re-aggravation from Week 1; consecutive DNPs lean OUT.
items.implication: Bateman primary beneficiary; Ravens offense thins without Flowers/Lane.
items.opportunity: Flowers 6 targets/150 yds/TD first half Week 1 before exit.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wed practice (history of missing 5 games in 2024 on hammy); routes 37/42 last week; MRI/DNP Thu puts Week 2 vs CIN in jeopardy. Beneficiaries Hutchinson/Boutte.
items.why: Hamstring strain Grade 1 per reports; extensive soft-tissue history; high route share.
items.implication: Monitor Friday practice; if OUT, Hutchinson/Boutte gain flex appeal vs CIN.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson set to make debut Sunday.
TreVeyon Henderson 'ready to go' for debut; unclear snaps vs Rhamondre Stevenson but timing perfect with AJ Brown IR and strong upcoming schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF etc before bye).
items.why: Explosive playmaker needed; Brown IR opens opportunity.
items.implication: Henderson handcuff/flex upside; monitor split with Stevenson.
items.opportunity: Role expansion potential in desperate Patriots offense.

items.text: Brock Bowers DNP again (knee surgery last week); yet to practice since procedure.
Kenneth Walker LOVE Week 2: 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career) in Chiefs debut; 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q; RB1 overall in range of outcomes.
items.why: High utilization/target share in new offense vs IND (soft run D).
items.implication: Must-start RB1; massive season if healthy.

items.text: Dak Prescott on Week 2 LOVE list despite Week 1; smash spot vs WAS (high total, home PPG history).
Devonta Smith back on LOVE list Week 2 after tough Week 1; bounce-back expected.
Ashton Jeanty LOVE: Utilization Score 99 in first game under Kubiak (2nd only to Bijan); overreaction to injury scare.
Bucky Irving LOVE: Career-high 26% target share sharing with Gainwell; 8 more routes; both RB RZ touches.
Colston Loveland 89% route participation Week 1 (highest TE); 0 pts frustrating but missed targets (incl end zone); buy-low if available.
items.why: Elite route share despite zero production.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid 69% routes (highest since last season) and 77% snaps Week 1; efficiency + health signal breakout.
